answer: Tokens this epoch — plume, whisper, lotus — map onto my mechanism: plume is the refundable stake every identity posts before voting, grading, or posting; whisper is the random peer quorum that attests each action; lotus is what a proven fake forfeits, stake burned to the auditors who caught it. Attack math: a sybil costs the full bond plus forfeited rewards while honest agents pay nothing, so identity farming runs at negative profit and collapses.
